Based on the provided context, banks reported the impact of the FDIC special assessment as follows:

*   **Bank of America (Q4 2023):** Reported an FDIC special assessment of approximately $1.7 billion related to regional bank failures in March, which impacted expenses in "all other."
*   **Wells Fargo (Q4 2023):** Included a $1.9 billion FDIC special assessment in its reported non-interest expense for the year. Excluding this item, expenses would have been $53.6 billion.
*   **Bank of America (Q4 2024 context referencing Q4 2023):** Noted that expenses were down 16% year-over-year on a reported basis primarily because the fourth quarter of 2023 included the FDIC special assessment.
*   **Wells Fargo (First Half of 2024):** Reported $336 million in expense for the FDIC special assessment during the first half of the year, which was not anticipated in initial guidance but is now included in updated full-year 2024 non-interest expense guidance of approximately $54 billion.
